summary.text: Annette Sweeney is a Republican Iowa state senator who has represented District 27 since 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business executive and former teacher, she previously served in the Iowa House of Representatives from 2009 to 2013.

paragraphs.text: Annette Sweeney earned a B.S. in education from Concordia College in 1980.
Her career experience includes owning Practical Promotions, serving as CEO of Sweeney Farms, working as a state director of USDA Rural Development, and teaching.

She served as executive director of the Iowa Angus Association and has served on the Ellsworth Community Ag Advisory Council, the Hardin County Extension Council and the Iowa Women in Agriculture Board.
Sweeney represented District 44 in the Iowa House of Representatives from 2009 to 2013 and has served in the Iowa State Senate since 2018.

For 2025-2026 she chairs the Natural Resources and Environment Committee and is vice chair of the International Relations Committee, and she also sits on the Agriculture, Commerce, Health and Human Services, Technology and Ways and Means committees.
